subject.title: fix(opencode): sync Zen/Go static catalogs to live + models.dev

question: Should OpenClaw retire `opencode/hy3-free` now and require affected users to run `openclaw doctor --fix` for the tested migration to `opencode/laguna-s-2.1-free`, rather than retaining a runtime compatibility alias?
rationale: The repository policy favors Doctor-owned migrations and canonical runtime shapes, but this PR intentionally changes the behavior of existing saved provider settings; only maintainers can confirm that the upgrade timing and replacement choice are acceptable.

options.title: Accept Doctor-only migration
options.body: Merge after rebase, keeping runtime fail-closed and relying on the tested plugin Doctor migration to repair affected saved references.

options.title: Preserve temporary runtime compatibility
options.body: Request a documented temporary alias or other compatibility path if maintainers judge that users cannot reasonably be expected to run Doctor before their next model resolution.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the new catalog rows and metadata work separate from removing the retired model until a release-level migration policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-only migration
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase, keeping runtime fail-closed and relying on the tested plugin Doctor migration to repair affected saved references.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contributor with direct context on the catalog-sync and broader freshness proposals; maintainer ownership still needs to be established through normal review.
